description: 50V 560pF C0G ±5% 0805 Multilayer Ceramic Capacitors MLCC - SMD/SMT ROHS
compatibility_notes: Second code on the existing generic 0805 560 pF capacitor: the plain generic ID keeps its reviewed preference C1751 (FH 0805B561K500NT, X7R +/-10% 50 V). C1829 is the exact FH C0G +/-5% SKU (0805CG561J500NT, 50 V) from the same maker, so it gets its own maker/mpn variant ID linked via generic_oomp_id, following the established variant taxonomy. Rating comparison from the staged capture: same 560 pF value, package and 50 V rating, but C0G +/-5% is the more stable, tighter-tolerance dielectric than the X7R +/-10% preference; projects needing C0G stability at 560 pF/0805 should pick this variant explicitly and the X7R preference is not downgraded. Two-terminal MLCC (pin_count 2); stock 7,544 recorded as observed. Edits made under the capacitor family lock.
